input_ref: Pharmacy advocate: when can i offer 90 day mail order on a maintenance drug

output.reason: None of the approved units fully answers when a 90-day mail order can be offered for a maintenance drug. U-RX-EDU-001-13 only says specialty drugs are not converted to mail order.
